_meta.verified_source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (Anthropic official pricing page, Model pricing table)
_meta.verify_note: Every rate below was checked against the official Anthropic pricing page on 2026-10-14. Re-check on the run day if the run happens later. Cache writes use the 5-minute rate because the harness only uses ephemeral (5-minute) cache breakpoints.
_meta.haiku_tiering: Official: Claude Haiku 5.5 prices a request by its prompt length (all input tokens, including cache reads and writes). Prompts up to 100,000 tokens use tier_low; over 100,000 use tier_high. The harness applies the tier per request.
_meta.sonnet_cache_read: Official page lists Sonnet 5.5 cache hits at $0.10/MTok (0.05x base input). The cut from $0.20 was announced by @claudeai on X on 2026-10-07 (https://x.com/claudeai/status/2107894060229034197; the post ID decodes to 2026-10-07 18:01 UTC).

tool_charges._note: BFCL tools are not executed in this protocol, so a_i = 0 for every step. Add per-call USD charges here when wiring real APIs.
